What's new

Release notes for every version of Tromi, newest first. Back to the Tromi page

1.0.7 Upcoming update

  • Gas prices update again on Android 13 and older, where they had stopped refreshing; stations the Régie reports as not in operation are now hidden, and a phantom station that skewed averages and the map's zoom is gone
  • EV chargers: a new "Free only" filter on the map, the list and Android Auto, with a tip when the free ones need Level 2 turned on — and about 1,800 more Open Charge Map stations now load
  • Gas Prices: the 12-month chart now follows your fuel filter (regular, premium or diesel), with a Canada-wide line to compare regular
  • Parks load again on a new install, with every park's outline, and Forillon and Kiamika show their new official names — your favourites are kept
  • The map now opens where you are when the app starts on the Map tab, instead of on your default location

1.0.6 August 2026

  • The map now follows your light/dark setting — basemap, markers and routes all adapt
  • Landscape: two-column layouts for detail screens, the trip planner, Guide, Settings, Incentives and Gas prices
  • Your ferry, park and rest-area favourites no longer disappear after a data refresh
  • Filters now show when each source last updated, and flag data that may be out of date
  • Leaner updates: less mobile data, and places removed by their operator no longer linger
  • Gas cards now show when the price last changed, plus an arrow comparing it to a week ago
  • Reverse a trip in one tap in the planner
  • Map markers can now be explored with TalkBack

1.0.5 July 2026

  • Fixed the filter panel — re-selecting include or exclude no longer clears your brand and operator choices
  • Fixed back navigation when the app opens on a tab other than the map
  • Places that disappear from the data now show "not found" instead of loading forever
  • Improved screen-reader support: chips and distances now read naturally with TalkBack
  • Android Auto: nearby stations now follow all your filters, and a clear message appears if location permission is missing

1.0.4 July 2026

  • Added Québec's official scenic routes — browse them in Destinations and plan a trip that follows one
  • The Destinations tab now gathers trips, scenic routes, attractions, and parks together, each with its own filters
  • Keep interesting places along a trip as saved spots, without adding them as a stop
  • Saved places now live in your Favorites
  • Fixed the home-screen price widget — tap it to refresh the price or re-pick your station

1.0.3 June 2026

  • Added a multi-stop trip planner with arrival times and suggestions for gas, chargers, rest areas, parks, and attractions along your route
  • Added a Destinations tab to save trips and places
  • Added Québec parks, tourist attractions, ferry schedules, and highway rest areas, with details and favorites
  • Android Auto now shows your active trip on the car screen
  • Added a 12-month gas price chart for Montréal and Québec City

1.0.2 April 2026

  • Fixed home screen widget going blank on cold boot or after long idle periods
  • Fixed widget display issues on rotation and when the station list is empty
  • Map branding and attribution button no longer hidden behind the bottom navigation bar
  • Reduced app download size

1.0.1 April 2026

  • Fixed widget showing double cent sign and placeholder on older devices
  • Improved map marker colors — now dynamically adjusted based on actual prices in your area
  • Added share button to easily share the app with friends
  • Improved battery life by skipping disabled data sources during background refresh
  • Fixed Help screen button overflow on smaller screens
